newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Bourse closes up 1.74 percent.
newsitem.headline: French Bourse closes up 1.74 percent.

text.p: French shares closed much higher ahead of an expected decision by the Federal Reserve Open Market Committee (FOMC) to raise U.S. interest rates by 0.25 percentage points, dealers said.
A strong start on Wall Street underpinned the French rise.
The CAC-40 index closed 44.97 points, or 1.74 percent, higher at 2,624.25.
Dealers said they were rather surprised by the strength of today's rally, but said the market was up in line with Treasury bonds, Wall Street and other markets.
"A quarter point rise has been discounted. People do not expect a bigger rise," a broker said.
A U.S. rate decision is not expected before 1900 GMT.
Volume was 6.72 billion francs including 4.78 billion in CAC-40 shares.
The March CAC future gained 25.5 points to 2,627.5.
* Lyonnaise and Cie de Suez remained active due to merger speculation.
* Cie Bancaire closed 4.25 percent higher at 761 francs.
* Schneider, up 2.44 percent to 301.80, is expected to post a 1996 net attributable profit of around 1.25 billion francs on Wednesday, up from 817 million a year ago.
* AXA-UAP, up 1.27 percent at 368 francs, is also expected to present its results on Wednesday with investors mainly looking for a progress report on the mega-merger.
